selector-missing: Source target {value} does not exist in {path}.
selector-ambiguous: Source target {value} is ambiguous in {path}. Use a unique anchor or object member.
selector-format: The declared target in {path} cannot be checked as UTF-8 HTML or valid JSON. Preserve the file and correct its declaration.
selector-limit: Target verification in {path} exceeds the supported HTML size/node count or JSON nesting limit. This target remains unresolved.
selector-boundary: The HTML target {value} in {path} has no unambiguous source element boundary.
qualification: Byte identity, declared coverage and source targets checked. HTML anchors select their element, not an inferred chapter or following section. Mappings, dates and scientific meaning still need import reconciliation. No records were imported or published.
title: Inspect external logbook
intro: Inspect a declared logbook export before planning a migration. The preview stays in this private session. Source files are read only.
sourceGuidance: Choose an export containing inventory.observanda-source.json. This adapter uses explicit declarations; it does not infer records from a website or arbitrary folder.
cancelled: Inspection cancelled. No records were imported.
interrupted: Inspection interrupted. Try again with a stable source.
finished: Inspection finished. Source files were not changed.
changed: Source selection changed. Inspect again to see its inventory.
unsafe: Unsafe path, link or file type. It was not read.
unaccounted: No object accounts for this file.
coverage: {mapped} proposed mappings, {excluded} exclusions, {blocked} blocked objects, {files} unaccounted or unsafe files.
boundary: No records have been imported. This checks original bytes, source targets and declared coverage. Import reconciliation and user review are still required.
limits: Limits: 10,000 objects, 20,000 filesystem entries, 1,000 source references per file, an 8 MiB manifest, 64 GiB source bytes and five minutes per inspection. HTML target checks accept UTF-8 files up to 8 MiB and 100,000 nodes; JSON target checks stream UTF-8 documents with nesting up to 128. Targets outside these limits remain unresolved. Links and archives are not followed or expanded.
verifying: Checking that the source stayed unchanged…
hashing: Checking original bytes: {files} files, {bytes} of {total} MiB
verificationMetrics: Inspection: {seconds} seconds; peak worker memory {memory} MiB.
invalidSource: Declare a source namespace, revision and title.
invalidObjects: The object list is missing or exceeds capacity.
invalidIdentity: An object needs a stable source ID, revision, kind and title.
invalidDisposition: Declare a disposition and intended audience.
invalidURLs: Use original HTTP(S) URLs with optional anchors and no credentials.
invalidDates: Declare date meanings and source values; use null for unknown dates.
invalidAttributes: Keep source attributes in a bounded object.
invalidFiles: Identify the original bytes for every object.
invalidOriginal: Use a safe relative path, original byte size and SHA-256 hash.
declareBoundary: Declare whole-file or exact source boundaries.
invalidLinks: Declare relationships, including an empty list when none are known.
invalidLink: Relationships need a type, exact target ID/revision and required flag.
tooManyReferences: Too many file references or relationships.
chooseManifest: Choose a declared logbook export containing the selected inventory manifest.
invalidManifest: Use a UTF-8 JSON inventory manifest.
duplicateIdentity: This source ID and revision occur more than once.
chooseAudience: Choose an explicit public or private intent.
unsafeOriginal: This file cannot be used as original evidence: {path}
changedOriginal: Original bytes differ from the declaration: {path}
requiredTarget: Required {type} target is missing, excluded or blocked: {id} @ {revision}
optionalTarget: An optional relationship target is unavailable: {id} @ {revision}
selector-encoding: The HTML file {path} declares a non-UTF-8 encoding. Its target remains unresolved; export an explicitly UTF-8 source before mapping this element.
